name: Stormbitten Wyvern · Thunderhead style
role: Boss style · Stormfront at night and during thunderstorms · same abilities
notes: Same rig, bones, animations and hitbox as the Stormbitten Wyvern; only textures change.
Storm-cloud grey-blue scales, dark iron-grey plates, and electric-blue lightning veins running through the wing membranes.
The horns and wing veins flash together when it casts Lightning. The splinter stays violet.
Spawns on Stormfront islands at night or during thunderstorms.
